text:
TAP_REQUEST
Description
This event is triggered once a security token obtained for certain HTTP transactions.
Changing score or action re-evaluates TAP enforcement logic.
Examples
when
TAP_REQUEST
{
if
{[
TAP
::
score
]
>
85
}
{
drop
}
}
